entry_points.summary: Derive slug, initialize run dirs/Run Brief, emit start event, handle existing BRAINSTORM.md.
If GRILL.md absent, ask 1-2 clarifying questions in prose, end turn, write GRILL.md from reply.
Infer WIDE_N from natural-language count signals; default 3, prose-many 6, initial cap 20.
Assemble identical payload with docs, optional Explore, terrain, GRILL seed, and input_hash.
Persona draw and parallel Claude/Codex/Gemini five-section ideators with failure policy.
Wide cost gate, overflow waves, overflow model handling, and N->K clustering.
Write BRAINSTORM.md, anti-bias check, ranked briefing, hard end-turn invariant.
HEAVY chosen_pair or LIGHT/MEDIUM chosen_framing discussion-loop finalization.
Shared diverge/refine two-ideator helper with optional cap.

invariants: Absent GRILL.md triggers conversational sharpening and end-turn before scope probe; a skip/go reply preserves raw topic.
Phase 1 scaffolding is identical for all ideators except persona prefixes.
Wide mode must present a conversational cost gate and wait for user confirmation before overflow dispatch.
Phase 3 writes BRAINSTORM.md and then hard-stops; no tool call or auto-selection before user reply.
HEAVY successful lock-in uses chosen_pair and removes chosen_framing; abandon uses chosen_framing: abandoned and no chosen_pair.
Re-spin supports diverge and refine; wide overflow passes cap=3, discussion re-spins are uncapped when cap is empty.
ideator_personas is always written, including <none> and failed slots.
gotchas: Old sharpen-vs-skip specificity heuristic is obsolete; current behavior always asks sharpening questions when GRILL.md is absent.
cheap-mixed overflow model logs a warning and falls back to haiku.
Wide overflow maximum is 9 total ideators; over-cap requests are reported to the user.
MAP.md is canonical terrain; approach-synthesis RESEARCH.md is skipped.
Clusterer failure is non-fatal and falls back to raw N framings.
Refine mode is positive-seed depth; diverge mode is anti-seed breadth.
